name: Sortable Data Table
description: A dark invoice table whose rows travel to their new places when sorted, with resizable columns, sweep-select checkboxes, a sticky header and keyboard grid navigation.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column key, header and kind (text, mono, entity, date, status, currency, number), plus width, minWidth, maxWidth, sortable and firstSort. The last column takes spare room.

props.name: data
props.description: Rows: an id plus a string or number per column key. Dates are ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

props.name: rows
props.description: Caps how many rows of data render. There is no virtualisation, so keep it to a page.

props.name: density
props.description: 36px or 52px rows. The table's own switch changes it too; onDensityChange reports it.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Checkbox column with select-all, sweep-select (press and drag across boxes), shift-click ranges and the floating selection bar.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Drag a header edge to resize, double-click it to reset, or Shift + ← / → with the header focused.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Pin the header and scroll rows inside maxHeight. Off, the table grows to fit every row.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Height of the scroll area, in px, when the header is sticky.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort. Headers cycle first direction, the other, then unsorted.

props.name: statuses
props.type: Record<string, { label: string; tone: "positive" | "warning" | "negative" | "neutral"; rank: number }>
props.description: Labels, dot colours and sort order for status columns.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading, also the grid's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: One quiet line under the title.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Buttons on the selection bar.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Empty-state text for no rows or no columns. An empty columns array renders a titled status instead of an invalid table.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for figures, dates and text sorting.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for currency columns.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: checked boxes, selected rows, the resize guide and the selection total.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the card, rows and selection bar.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when a header changes the sort (null when cleared).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the selected row ids after every change.

props.name: onDensityChange
props.description: Called when the density switch changes.

props.name: onColumnResize
props.description: Called when a resize ends, with the new width in px.

props.name: onBulkAction
props.description: Called when a selection bar button is pressed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.
